name: resend-mcp
description: Resend (messaging): me, send, list_inbound. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_resend_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_RESEND_API_KEY
platform_mcp_resend_api_key.description: Resend team API key (re_…), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer re_xxxxxxxxx' (https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/introduction).

platform_mcp_resend_sender.title: PLATFORM_MCP_RESEND_SENDER
platform_mcp_resend_sender.description: Verified-domain sender address used as `from` on every send ('Sender email address', 'Name <email@domain>' allowed; https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/send-email). Env: PLATFORM_MCP_RESEND_SENDER.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Verified by listing one API key (Resend has no account endpoint); account carries the list envelope (object, has_more, data).

tools.name: send
tools.description: `from` comes from the per-install `sender` config field; `to` is one recipient address; `subject` is required by Resend (the API rejects a missing subject → isError); `text` is sent as the plain-text body; `channel` is ignored. message_id is the Resend email id.

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.description: Emails received by the team (needs MX on a verified domain). Resend pages by id cursor (`after` / `before`), so `page` is ignored and only the newest `limit` emails are returned; `since` and `channel` are not sent. The list carries no body: `text` is unset (subject is under raw.subject; the body is on GET /emails/receiving/{id}). `to` is the first recipient.
